name: Nicki Thiim
features: fair skin, red hair, full red beard, broad face, stocky build, wide grin
bio: Son of the 1986 DTM champion Kurt Thiim, and one third of the all-Danish "Dane Train" Aston Martin. Took the GTE Pro world title in 2016 with Marco Sørensen, and is impossible to mistake for anyone else on a grid.
